name: Light and Darkness
description: A celestial host and Halloween horrors wage war across the Blind Eternities.

customCards.name: Sunspire, Hall of the Host
customCards.rulesText:
At the beginning of your end step, if you attacked with one or more creatures this turn, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
Whenever chaos ensues, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying.

customCards.name: Choir of Seven Stars
customCards.rulesText:
Creature tokens you control have vigilance.
Whenever chaos ensues, create two 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.

customCards.name: Dawnward Basilica
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Whenever chaos ensues, you gain 3 life and draw a card.

customCards.name: Reliquary of Mercy
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, you may pay {1}. If you do, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Whenever chaos ensues, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand.

customCards.name: Sevenfold Gate
customCards.rulesText:
Creatures you control with flying get +1/+0.
Whenever chaos ensues, tap up to one target creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.

customCards.name: Crown of First Light
customCards.rulesText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, up to one target creature you control gains flying until end of turn.
Whenever chaos ensues, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.

customCards.name: Celestial Musterfield
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever one or more creatures you control attack, you gain 1 life.
Whenever chaos ensues, creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.

customCards.name: Pilgrim's Skyroad
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control, if you cast it from your hand, scry 1.
Whenever chaos ensues, search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

customCards.name: Sanctuary of the Unbroken
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it attacks, it gains lifelink until end of turn.
Whenever chaos ensues, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. You gain 2 life.

customCards.name: Hollowmoon Cemetery
customCards.rulesText:
At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Whenever chaos ensues, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

customCards.name: Gloamwood, the Crooked Mile
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever one or more Zombies or Spirits you control attack, each opponent loses 1 life.
Whenever chaos ensues, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

customCards.name: Harvest of the Hollow
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever a nontoken creature dies, its controller mills two cards.
Whenever chaos ensues, each player sacrifices a creature. Each player who can't loses 3 life.

customCards.name: Lanternless Village
customCards.rulesText:
Creatures your opponents control enter the battlefield tapped.
Whenever chaos ensues, tap up to two target creatures. Those creatures don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.

customCards.name: Manor of the Pale Count
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever an opponent discards a card, that player loses 1 life.
Whenever chaos ensues, each opponent discards a card. You draw a card for each card discarded this way.

customCards.name: The Pumpkin Crown
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever one or more tokens you control leave the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life.
Whenever chaos ensues, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token and a Food token.

customCards.name: The Witching Orchard
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, scry 1.
Whenever chaos ensues, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying for each opponent.

customCards.name: Briar-Sworn Crossroads
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever you cast a creature spell, you lose 1 life and draw a card.
Whenever chaos ensues, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

customCards.name: The Midnight Masquerade
customCards.rulesText:
Whenever a creature attacks you, its controller loses 1 life.
Whenever chaos ensues, create a 1/1 black Vampire creature token with lifelink for each opponent.

customCards.name: The Parade of Lost Souls
customCards.rulesText: When you encounter The Parade of Lost Souls, each player sacrifices a creature. For each creature sacrificed this way, its controller creates a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.

customCards.name: Eclipse of the Harvest Moon
customCards.rulesText: When you encounter Eclipse of the Harvest Moon, exile up to one target creature card from each graveyard. For each card exiled this way, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
